requirements.source_clause_or_field: section 0 machine binding and execution boundary
requirements.requirement_text: The task is limited to develop-branch faithful implementation, verification and Planner review; no formal training, outer access, Docker, upload, organizer email or develop-to-main merge is authorized.
requirements.scientific_rationale: This preserves the user's experimental authorization boundary.

requirements.source_clause_or_field: section 3 unique trunk and three high-resolution paths
requirements.requirement_text: Implementation must provide one stock-compatible 3D nnU-Net trunk with independent anatomy, scar and edema high-resolution paths; old entries may only thin-forward to the canonical implementation.
requirements.threshold_source: section 3 parameter byte coverage at least 0.99
requirements.scientific_rationale: Faithful reimplementation requires real stock trunk inheritance and independent pathology branches.

requirements.source_clause_or_field: section 3 stock-compatible logits parity when new evidence is disabled
requirements.requirement_text: With new evidence disabled, stock-compatible logits must match FP32 stock logits within the specified tolerance and argmax changed voxels must be zero.
requirements.threshold_source: section 3 explicitly states max absolute error <= 1e-6 and argmax changed voxels 0 for stock-compatible parity
requirements.scientific_rationale: Stock compatibility is a stated initialization/parity requirement, not a tiled-context equality requirement.

requirements.source_clause_or_field: sections 4 and 9 modality roles and no-T2
requirements.requirement_text: Scar, edema and no-T2 modality ownership must follow the frozen branch rules; no-T2 rows must not execute edema-owned subgraphs and class 4 must be excluded from loss/decode competition.
requirements.threshold_source: section 9 explicitly requires zero edema-owned calls, losses and gradients on no-T2 rows
requirements.scientific_rationale: Missing T2 must not be treated as negative edema evidence.

requirements.requirement_text: Single-tile and sliding-window inference must use the same public canonical inference path/settings; multi-tile inference must use genuine tile-local model forwards; tiles may emit only base logits, wall evidence and extent evidence; global extent/wall bias is applied exactly once after aggregation.
requirements.threshold_source: sections 8 and 14 state one post-aggregation bias application and genuine sliding-window path; the tile-count minimum is the mechanical definition of a multi-tile probe
requirements.scientific_rationale: Inference must preserve the architecture's full-volume semantics without hidden full-support pseudo-tiling.

derived_invariants.logical_derivation: A genuine tile-local sliding-window path cannot secretly expand each tile input to full-volume support.
derived_invariants.why_necessary: Otherwise the implementation would not test or run the contracted tiled inference path.

requirements.requirement_text: The total loss must include the declared terms with eligible-row normalization and finite gradients; forbidden losses and detached straight-through loss substitutions are not allowed.
requirements.scientific_rationale: Loss semantics define the faithful training objective even though formal training is not authorized.

derived_invariants.logical_derivation: A declared loss that enters total loss must provide finite nonzero direct gradients to its target module on eligible data.
derived_invariants.why_necessary: Otherwise the declared objective is not actually optimized.

requirements.requirement_text: Runtime evidence must be zero-credit and finite; checkpoints must bind the fold, stock checkpoint, schedule and exact resume state without starting formal training.
requirements.scientific_rationale: Runtime probes prove executable behavior without authorizing training evidence.

derived_invariants.logical_derivation: A checkpoint that claims exact resume must restore optimizer, scheduler, RNG and next-step descriptors consistently.
derived_invariants.why_necessary: Otherwise exact resume is not true.

requirements.requirement_text: Verifier, Executor and Controller must keep separate authority: Verifier builds contract-conformance oracles, Executor implements, Controller routes and integrates.
requirements.scientific_rationale: Role separation prevents self-verifying implementation and contract drift.

diagnostic_observations.description: Real CNN one-tile and forced multi-tile logits may differ because receptive-field context differs; max/mean differences and changed voxels are recorded for Planner review but are not a blocking threshold without a ledger-backed requirement.
